observations.finding: Disabled flag or non-I8 returns 1. Width and height each call getTexelOrder, then narrow to u16. Tile = x/8 + (width/8)*(y/4), byte = tile*32 + (x%8) + (y%4)*8, unsigned sample /255.

Initial coordinate <=1 bypasses all wrapping, including negative inputs. Clamp sets1 for >1; repeat and mirror both repeatedly subtract1 until <=1, then add1 while negative. Final fctiwz truncates (dimension-1)*coordinate.

Descriptor types contribute [0,1,1,2] byte widths; requires position, normal, UV offsets. Reads raw16bit primitive count and indices; later vertices overwrite position mapping. CPU endian boundary must not treat retained DL bytes as host u16.
Skips selected shape and material names containing Fur. Other shapes with position descriptor set both index fields to FFFF for every referenced position.

Swaps transformed buffer first. First UV pass ignores sentinel UV, gathers extrema starting0 and truncates range+0.45. S16 UV divides by its scale and integer span, then adds1 if negative; F32 samples directly. Mapped normals normalized; position converts independently. Mask==0 displaces -1 normal, else _1C*mask. Publishes actual output buffer after DCStoreRange.
After two ABI prefix words, original virtual slots are calc, setup, destructor; current shared J3DUnkCalc1 interface order agrees.
